human_question.description: Ask only when an unresolved acceptance choice blocks further editing, or when the code contradicts a fact the plan states. Then cite the plan fact and the code, and build nothing. Otherwise null.
human_question.title: Human Question

no_change.description: Only on a first attempt with no edits and no human_question: the checks showing the acceptance already holds on the pinned base, and their results. Otherwise null.
no_change.title: No Change

human_question.description: When this stage returns needs_human, put the question for the person here. Use null otherwise.
human_question.title: Human Question

research.description: The cited answer for the pinned base. Use null only when asking the human for missing evidence.
research.title: Research

ruling_id.description: Give the applicable settled ruling ID, or null.
ruling_id.title: Ruling Id

findings.description: List evidenced findings in the full current PR.
findings.title: Findings

human_question.description: Ask only if unresolved intent changes the verdict, otherwise null.
human_question.title: Human Question

exists.description: Set true for a seam that already exists in the checkout. Otherwise use false.
exists.title: Exists

name.description: Use the same short identifier in every slice that builds or uses this seam.
name.title: Name

path.description: For an existing seam, give a workspace-relative file path. Otherwise use null.
path.title: Path

Slice.description: One pull request's outcome and its proof obligations.

acceptance.description: State how to check the outcome, including response and other behavior checks.
acceptance.title: Acceptance

builds.description: List only new seams this slice provides for other slices, with exists false and path null. A seam is an interface, module, or contract, not a file; a new seam may be implemented in an existing file. Pure file edits belong in uses and acceptance/spec, not builds.
builds.title: Builds

properties.description: List only named PostgreSQL CHECK, UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY, EXCLUSION, or NOT NULL constraints. Use an empty list when the slice adds no database rule.
properties.title: Properties

repository.description: Explicit slice repository as OWNER/NAME, or null to inherit the admitted repository.
repository.title: Repository

screen.description: When the change alters a screen described under docs/screens/, name that Markdown file directly under docs/screens/ without '..'. Use an empty string when no documented screen changes.
screen.title: Screen

stateful.description: Set true when the slice changes behavior across states or transitions.
stateful.title: Stateful

uses.description: List seams this slice needs, including existing seams it edits with exists true and a workspace-relative path. Describe the edit in acceptance/spec. Edit-only example: builds: [], uses: [{name: items, exists: true, path: items.py}], acceptance: Change visible(items) to include closed items. Use an empty list when there are none.
uses.title: Uses
